title: 不打价格战：超高端婴配粉市占率创新高，为何能逆势增长？
speaker: Laetitia Garnier

segments.en: What is sort of the pricing environment now when it comes to infant formula? Because I think, you know, it's been quite competitive. And I think we've seen some of your peers in China, for example, have had to really, I've seen a contraction in their margins, just given the pricing environment now.
segments.zh: 目前婴幼儿配方奶粉的定价环境如何？竞争相当激烈，我们看到一些同行在中国市场因定价环境而利润率收缩。

segments.en: I mean, how are you in some ways navigating around the sort of change in the industry? I mean, what is the pricing environment now and look like to you?
segments.zh: 您是如何应对行业变化的？您眼中的定价环境是怎样的？

segments.en: It's a fair question, right? Like I said, we are not a price-led brand. Most of our growth is coming in the form of volume-led growth. We operate into the super premium segment. We are not into the mid-tier or the mastery, right?
segments.zh: 问得好。如我所说，我们不是价格导向的品牌。我们的增长主要来自销量驱动。我们专注于超高端市场，不涉足中端或大众市场。

segments.en: Because we believe a consumer education is a key to success, right? So in this first half, our super premium market share reached an all-time high of 20.6% percentage point compared to 14.8% for the same period last year.
segments.zh: 因为我们相信消费者教育是成功的关键。上半年，我们在超高端市场的份额达到历史新高20.6%，而去年同期为14.8%。

segments.en: So we're not downgrading it. We are, in fact, one of the fastest-going brands into the super premium segment.
segments.zh: 所以我们没有降级，事实上，我们是超高端市场中增长最快的品牌之一。

segments.en: And even in the Swiss, our adult nutrition care business, we are increasing percentage contribution from premiumization of our portfolio that is helping us to hit a higher cross margin threshold and invest more into marketing.
segments.zh: 即使在Swisse，我们的成人营养护理业务，也在提高高端产品组合的贡献，这帮助我们达到更高的毛利率门槛，并增加营销投入。

segments.en: So we have taken an approach that our differentiation will come in the form of consumer education, then downgrading of consumers.
segments.zh: 因此，我们的差异化策略是通过消费者教育，而不是消费者降级。
